heading: The survey lead your project calls first.
paragraphs: I've spent 25 years in heavy civil construction — marine, tunnel, highway, bridge, and federal work — most of it running survey. That means field-level technical depth and the management side too: budgets, subcontractors, submittals, and owner relationships.

I'm a California Professional Land Surveyor (licensed 2022, after passing both the national FS and PS exams). I also hold AGC's Certificate of Management – Building Information Modeling and an undergraduate certificate in project management. I'm OSHA 30 certified and a U.S. Marine Corps veteran.
highlight: As Survey Manager I ran survey across a $4.55 billion portfolio of three simultaneous projects — personnel, subcontractors, budgets, and stakeholders — while staying close enough to the data to catch what others miss.
